digest.component_or_area: outbound comment differ / dedup key derivation
propositions: Under rich_text_cutover=cloud, outbound comment differ computes body-equality keys with different decoders (local side escapes via normalize_outbound markdown round-trip, Jira side does not escape via adf_to_text), causing already-landed markdown comments to be re-emitted as duplicate mutations

The send path encodes a decorated comment body, and markdown_to_adf's fallback degrades the entire document to plain text when HTML comments are present, so the landing wire differs structurally from what the local undecorated round-trip produces

Fix: derive the local dedup key by predicting the exact as-sent wire (decorate → fit → encode) and decoding it with the same _normalize_comment_body used on the Jira side, eliminating the decode asymmetry
Defect originated in commit 27b868ba55 when send path moved to codec ADF encoding of decorated body while leaving Jira-side decode on normalize_rich_text/adf_to_text, creating asymmetry
In-limit markdown comments with markdown-active characters (asterisks, brackets, autolinks) within the 32,000-char budget never match their landed bodies due to escaping divergence in the dedup key

The fix is verified across 8-cell matrix (cutover off/cloud × in-limit/over-length markdown and plain text): new one-decoder key matches landed form in all cells, no regression in previously-matching cells
